    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)
    
    # Create a quadratic program
    qp = QuadraticProgram()
    qp.binary_var_list(graph_vertices)
    
    # Define the objective function
    # Modularity score
    modularity_score = 0
    # Normalized cut score
    normalized_cut_score = 0
    # Balance constraint score
    balance_constraint_score = 0
    
    # Add constraints
    # Balance constraint
    for i in range(p_layers):
        qp.linear_constraint(graph_vertices, '==', len(graph_vertices) / p_layers, 'balance_constraint_' + str(i))
    
    # Convert to QUBO
    qp2qubo = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo = qp2qubo.convert(qp)
    
    # Set up QAOA
    backend = AerSimulator(seed_simulator=seed)
    optimizer = {'name': 'COBYLA', 'maxiter': maxiter}
    qaoa = QAOA(backend, optimizer, reps=p_layers)
    
    # Solve the problem
    result = qaoa.solve(qubo)
    
    # Calculate metrics
    partition = [int(bit) for bit in result.x]
    modularity_score = calculate_modularity(G, partition)
    normalized_cut_score = calculate_normalized_cut(G, partition)
    balance_constraint_score = calculate_balance_constraint(partition, len(graph_vertices) / p_layers)
    
    # Calculate approximation ratio

    # Calculate runtime

    # Calculate reproducibility
